title: Parking prediction model training method and system based on federal learning and block chain
assignee: Qingdao E Link Information Technology Co ltd

pse.problem: Existing parking prediction model has a timeliness problem due to training only on fixed historical data
pse.solution_function: A method combining federal learning and blockchain technology for continuous training of a parking prediction model. The method collects and processes historical parking data, trains local models using the processed data, aggregates parameters of the local models through intelligent contracts, updates the global model based on aggregated parameters, and checks convergence. If not converged, it acquires global model parameters from the blockchain and updates local models.
pse.solution_structure: A parking lot with historical data collection system, a federation of nodes (each node has a local model), a blockchain network with intelligent contracts managing model parameters, and each participant's system for updating the local model.
pse.solution_implementation: Data collection, processing, and training are done locally. Parameters of the trained local models are uploaded to the blockchain through smart contracts where they are aggregated to form global model parameters. The global model is established based on these parameters. If not converged, the global model parameters are acquired from the blockchain and sent to each participant for updating their local models.
pse.effect: The proposed method addresses the timeliness problem by continuously training the parking prediction model using real-time data from the blockchain.
